notes: A standard full basketball court is Sports, and space-bounded is the genre's Bounded Court — the painted perimeter is the whole structure of the space, with the arena around it as its enclosure. Court Sport is the preset, giving out-of-bounds detection, the hoops as scoring targets and the tip-off spot; the answers add a compact indoor arena with hardwood and simple bleachers, so barrier-perimeter closes the room and spectator-bleachers supplies the stepped seating, which is what puts tiered on an otherwise plain P0. I considered interior-single since the whole map is indoors, but the court's perimeter is what defines this space and the arena is its shell, and either way there is no exterior to link so no transition and no P3. The prompt gave nothing but the court, so I took the answers as the whole brief: one new regulation-proportioned full court, no crowd, no second court.
